title: The Goto Revolution: the long wait ends
summary: Hirooki Goto’s repeated failures to win New Japan’s top title become the emotional basis of one more pursuit. An unexpected Dome opportunity leads to his defining breakthrough against Zack Sabre Jr.

chapters.title: Goto earns another chance
chapters.result: Goto wins the Ranbo to secure a world-title shot.
chapters.context: Eliminating Great-O-Khan gives the veteran a fresh opening after years of near misses.

chapters.title: Goto finally wins the world championship
chapters.result: Goto defeats Sabre for the IWGP World Heavyweight title.
chapters.context: The long pursuit ends with the veteran finally holding New Japan’s leading championship.
